project_type: Laravel 12 full-stack web application with Tailwind CSS 4, Alpine.js, Vite, MySQL 8
build_system: Composer (PHP) + npm (Node.js, Vite). Run: `composer install && npm install`
test_framework: PHPUnit (configured for MySQL-only testing). Run: `php artisan config:clear && php artisan test`
build_command: npm run build (Vite compilation); php artisan view:cache
test_command: php artisan test (full suite) or php artisan test --filter=<pattern>
verification_instructions: 1. php artisan migrate (apply migrations). 2. php artisan db:seed --class=<SeederName> (populate data). 3. Navigate to /back/consumption-readings/previsions in browser or curl API endpoint. 4. Run console command: php artisan drought:refresh-forecasts. 5. Verify database: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumption_forecasts; should return >0.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. All data is in MySQL only. Chart.js graphs are generated client-side from data.
environment_constraints: MySQL 8 only (not SQLite). Database queue driver active (php artisan queue:listen required for jobs). QUEUE_CONNECTION=database and CACHE_STORE=database in .env. API routes use public endpoints (no auth). All times in Laravel timezone (config/app.php). French month labels via Carbon::translatedFormat().
contribution_requirements: No git commits (per user request). All files written to app/, routes/, database/, resources/ directly. Follow existing style: Tailwind CSS dark mode (dark:bg-white/[0.03]), x-back.* Blade components, numeric format with French locale (spaces for thousands).
key_patterns: 1. Controllers: Inject service via constructor, return view/JSON. 2. Models: HasFactory trait, relation methods, casts. 3. Services: Static helpers or dependency-injected; logic separated from HTTP. 4. Jobs: Implement ShouldQueue, dispatch via dispatchSync/dispatch. 5. Blade: Use translatedFormat() for dates, match() for conditionals, @foreach for loops. 6. Chart.js: Initialize via x-data Alpine binding or inline <script>. 7. Dark mode: Use dark: prefix in Tailwind classes.
directory_structure: app/ (services, controllers, models, jobs), database/ (migrations, seeders, factories), routes/ (web.php + new api.php), resources/views/ (Blade templates organized by section), resources/js/ (Vite assets), config/ (Laravel configuration), storage/ (logs, cache), public/ (static assets)
